next.reason: 1985: "{ BEFORE | AFTER } ADVANCING … [ AT END-OF-PAGE … ] [ NOT AT END-OF-PAGE … ]"; 2023: "choice indicators around BEFORE/AFTER and around END-OF-PAGE/NOT END-OF-PAGE; adds FILE file-name-1, FROM literal-1, retry-phrase, LOCK". 2023 allows BEFORE and AFTER together and the EOP phrases in any order, which 1985 refused. It also adds FILE, FROM literal, RETRY and LOCK phrases.
